name: American Museum & Gardens
description:
American Museum & Gardens
Claverton Manor
Bath BA2 7BD
United Kingdom
+4401225460503
Visit Site

Set on the edge of Bath, UK, looking over the rolling Cotswold Hills, the American Museum & Gardens occupies 125 acres of parkland surrounding the historic Claverton Manor, offering the ultimate country escape from the city. Blending English landscape tradition with American design, the “New American Garden” features the only public Oehme, van Sweden garden in Europe, showcasing bold swathes of American perennials, grasses, and shrubs within an English country garden setting. The Mount Vernon Garden is inspired by George Washington’s estate,  plus there’s an arboretum and walks through traditional woodland and parkland. Together, these diverse landscapes celebrate the rich botanical and cultural connections between the United Kingdom and the United States.

1400 Avalon Cyn Road
Avalon, CA  90704

310-510-2595

Visit Site

Wrigley Memorial & Botanic Garden, operated by the Catalina Island Conservancy, covers 38 acres on Catalina Island featuring it’s native and endemic plant species. The Botanic Garden is a great location to immerse yourself in nature in Avalon Canyon.  The centerpiece of the Botanic Garden, the Wrigley Memorial is an iconic landmark which honors William Wrigley Jr., whose greatest legacy was his vision for Catalina Island to remain protected for future generations to enjoy.

Imua Discovery Garden is a serene, family-friendly escape where nature, history, and learning come alive. Wander beneath majestic monkey-pod trees, explore interactive exhibits, and connect with Maui’s rich cultural and environmental heritage. With a past that spans Maui’s native chiefs and Hawaii’s plantation era, this six-acre oasis offers a unique blend of relaxation, education, and adventure. Whether seeking tranquility or discovery, Imua Discovery Garden is a must-visit destination on Hawaii’s enchanting Valley Isle.

description:

Canada R0K 0E0

Visit Site

Founded in 1932, the International Peace Garden celebrates the enduring peace and friendship between the United States of America and Canada. Visitors can explore nearly 2,400 acres of beautifully maintained landscapes, anchored by the magnificent Formal Gardens. More than 100,000 flowering annuals and perennials fill terraced beds and scenic walkways, highlighted by a stunning Sunken Garden and an 18-foot floral clock. Guests can also enjoy the year-round Conservatory, home to approximately
5,000 unique species and cultivars of cacti and succulents from around the world.

Visit our website for current hours, seasonal features, and border reentry information.

name: Texas Discovery Gardens
description:
3601 Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard
Dallas, Texas 75210
(214) 428-7476

Visit Site
To Note: Reciprocal visitors are offered a 50% discount from regular admission prices. Not applicable for special events or classes.

Explore, Experience, Entertain, and Educate at Texas Discovery Gardens.

Our 7.5-acre, 100% organic gardens showcase Texas native and adaptive plants. Visit the Rosine Smith Sammons Butterfly House for our daily butterfly release and exploration of hundreds of exotic butterflies in a tropical rainforest. Discover our local art gallery, garden trains, snake and reptile shack, and children’s playscape with a rock-climbing wall. Relax in the Secret Garden with soothing fountains and enjoy family picnics on our circular lawn. Join us for educational, craft, and social events, species exhibits, and volunteer opportunities, and experience the beauty and wonder of our natural world. And don’t forget our award-winning gift shop with something for everyone.
